name: After § 13
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 13a. Recalls that workers and their organisations have played a prominent role in developing plans for reconverting production to sustainable alternatives, for example in the steel and automotive sectors; urges the Commission to take measures that give workers the tools to have a tangible influence in the necessary transition of industry, as they have the most extensive expertise regarding production processes;
